meta.name: generate-voice-guide
meta.description: Generate a personal voice guide for X (Twitter) and/or LinkedIn by scanning a user's past posts and iteratively refining with sample-and-feedback loops. Produces a structured markdown voice guide that sibling skills (create-x-content, create-linkedin-content) consume to draft in-voice posts. Different from brand-voice-extractor, which analyses company blogs/landing pages — this skill is for personal social voice.
